Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us. Pakistan have taken a 1-0 lead in the 4-match T20I series. West Indies will look to come back stronger in the next game after this disappointing performance. We now head to Port of Spain for the second T20I which will take  place on March 30th, 2017 at 1230 local ( 1630 GMT). Until then, goodbye and cheers.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed thanks the Almighty first up. Credits the bowlers for bowling extremely well and performing the way they did. Mentions his side have the psychological edge over West Indies and they want to continue with it. Says he told Shadab Khan to bowl just like he did in the Pakistan T20 League and ends by saying that he does not want his team to ease the pressure off the Windies now.

Man of the Match, Shadab Khan thanks the almighty. Says that it was a dream debut for him and hopes that he will continue to do so. Adds that the conditions were similar to the wickets he played in the Pakistan T20 League. Ends by saying that the pitch did help the spinners.

West Indies skipper, Carlos Brathwaite says they came out and did not expect what happened to happen. Mentions they did not bat well as the debutant Shadab Khan bowled well and it was difficult to come back after the collapse in the middle. Adds each player must know how to play against every bowler, have a gameplan against them and then play accordingly, as it is detrimental to the team. States that he is happy with his individual performance as a lot of hard work went in it.

The West Indies bowlers didn't have much to defend. They did put up a fight and did the best they could, but some more runs from their batsmen could have made the game more interesting in the very least. The hosts plucked some wickets at regular intervals, but they were always going to need a miracle from somewhere to pull this one off. Earlier in the day, a stupendous bowling display led by debutant Shadab Khan saw West Indies being restricted to 111.

A comfortable win for Pakistan to say the least. With the scoreboard pressure virtually non-existent and just a paltry target of 112 to chase, Pakistan were always in control of the game. Got off to a steady start and then a solid 46-run stand between Babar Azam and Shoaib Malik was more than enough to ensure that the visiting side won this game with ease.

FOUR! That should do it! Shoaib Malik finishes things off in style. Leans into this full length delivery and drives it through the gap in the covers for a boundary. PAKISTAN WIN BY 6 WICKETS WITH 17 BALLS TO SPARE AND LEAD THE SERIES 1-0!
Length delivery around off, driven to the left of mid off for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Malik swings his bat through the line but fails to make contact.
Coming in on middle and leg, turns it through square leg for a couple more.

SIX! He's really got hold of that one! BANG! What a hit. Back of a length around off, Shoaib Malik is expecting that one as he hangs back to it. Pulls it high and handsome over the wide long on boundary for a huge maximum. Just 4 runs needed to win this match now.
Arrows in a full delivery on off, angles it in as Sarfraz drives it to mid on. Takes Holder on but a misfield from him sees the batsmen complete the run with ease.
Short of a length delivery on off, cramping Malik for room but he still manages to get this away. Hops and whips it to the right of mid on for a single.
Carlos Brathwaite is back into the attack.
Gives it some decent air and floats it on off, Shoaib Malik goes back and turns it to the square leg region for an easy single. Pakistan need 12 more runs to win off 24 deliveries.
Turning in from around off, on a length, Malik goes back and taps it down on the track.
Full and attacking the stumps, eased back down to long on for one run.
Another flat ball well outside off, Sarfraz cuts this late past the first slip fielder and picks up a couple of runs for doing so.
Another full ball on off, driven back down to long on for a single.
Darts it full and flat outside off, pushed off the front foot straight to the cover fielder.
Sunil Narine is also brought into the attack.
Sarfraz Ahmed strides into the middle next.

OUT! Azam throws it away! Fuller delivery outside off, Azam stays in his crease and goes hard at it to put it over the cover region. He gets an outside edge to it and the ball flies towards the fielder at short third man. Rovman Powell takes a simple catch and Jason Holder raises his hands to celebrate. Can the Windies trigger a collapse?
Full delivery outside off, Malik driven through point for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Babar shuffles a bit and cuts it through point for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam shuffles across and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
FOUR! Improvisation! Short delivery in the line of the stumps, Azam rightly knows the fielding arrangement as he shuffles across to pull it over the short fine leg region for a boundary.
Short delivery into the body, Malik nudges it on the leg side for a single.
Jason Holder is brought into the bowling attack.
Back of a length delivery angling into the stumps, Malik pulls it through the square leg region for a single.
Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Azam pulls it fine on the leg side for a single.
Wide! Way down the leg side, Azam goes for a pull but misses. The keeper appeals for a caught behind but the umpire calmy indicates it as a wide.
On the pads, Azam clips it through square leg for a couple.
FOUR! One bounce over the ropes! Slower length delivery around off, Azam heaves it towards wide of long on for a boundary. The fielder from long on could not cut it off.
Short and outside off, Malik stays deep in his crease and guides it late towards short third man for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Malik defends it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Kieron Pollard is called into the attack.
Malik pushes it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Short delivery around off, Malik plays an awkward pull shot through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Lendl Simmon tries to stop it with his legs but fails to do so.
Short delivery into the body, kicks up a bit more after hitting the deck. Malik stays deep in his crease and defends it off the splice.
On the pads, Malik clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery angling into the body, Malik flicks it through the backward square leg region. Holder makes a good stop to save the boundary. The batsmen run a couple.
Fuller delivery into the pads, Azam clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Eased towards long on for a single.
Down the leg side, Azam paddles it fine down the leg side for a couple.
Around off, Malik eases it through covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up outside off, Babar pushes it through covers for a single.
Floated outside off, Malik stays deep and pushes it through covers for a single.

Slower one just outside off, Malik clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple. The fielder comes steaming in from the deep and has a shy at the non-striker's end. He misses and Samuel Badree there misfields it and lets the batsmen run a single off the overthrow as well. So, three runs in total.
Good length delivery around off, Babar shuffles and pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Babar defends it with soft hands and calls for a single. Malik sends him back.
Yorker length delivery outside off, Azam tries to dig it out but fails to make contact.
Free Hit coming up on the next delivery...
Good length delivery angling in from outside off, Babar goes for a cut but misses it. Williams has overstepped this time.
Wide! Way wide outside off and short this time, Babar stays undisturbed.
Angling into the pads, Babar stays in his crease and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length delivery around off, Babar stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at extra cover.
Kesrick Williams is into the attack now.
FOUR! Deft from Shoaib Malik. Waits for this, plays it very late as he cuts it away across the third man fence for a boundary.
Pushed quicker through the air on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Flatter ball outside off, eased away through to sweeper cover by Babar for a run.
Turning in on middle and leg, goes back and punches it back down the track.
Darts this full and flat on off, Babar Azam comes ahead and plays it back in the direction of the bowler.
Starts off with a flatter and shorter ball outside off, punched away towards the covers off the back foot for one.
Sunil Narine is back into the attack.
IN THE AIR... BUT IT'S SAFE! Angling in on a good length, Shoaib Malik flicks it uppishly towards short mid-wicket. Nobody there and so he's safe. A single is taken as the ball rolls towards mid on.
Length delivery outside off, cut away straight to the point fielder.
Shoaib Malik makes his way out to the middle.
Carlos Brathwaite is getting some treatment from the physio there.

OUT! HAFEEZ IS OUTTA HERE! Short and around off, Hafeez looks to pull but gets a big top edge on this one. It balloons towards the vacant silly point position as Brathwaite and Walton both go for the catch. They collide, but the skipper manages to hold on to the ball. They have a little laugh looking at each other but Carlos seems to be hurt. Don't blame him, practically got speared in the rib cage. But Hafeez is gone and Pakistan lose their third wicket.
Back of a length delivery into the body, Babar pulls it away through to deep square leg for one more.
On a length and well outside off, cut away late down towards third man for one run.
Length delivery well outside off, cut away firmly by Mohammad Hafeez but straight to the point fielder.
Flicks it away on the leg side again and that will be the end of the over.
Turns this away against the spin on the leg side but won't get any run for it.
Floats this on a driving length, around off, invites Babar Azam forward to defend. Gets an inside edge onto his front pad as it rolls away on the off side.
Full on middle and leg, Hafeez gets low to this one and sweeps it down towards fine leg for a run.
Nicely tossed up on middle and leg, flicked off the inside half through square leg for a single.
Loopy and fullish in length around off, comes ahead and pushes it through to sweeper cover for one.
Outside off on a good length, dabbed square on the off side for an easy single.
Bowls it slightly ahead of a length, just around off, Hafeez prods forward and pushes it in front of covers.
Length delivery outside off, Hafeez looks to cut but is a little cramped for room. Cannot connect and sees the ball thud into the keeper's gloves.
Coming into the rib cage, Babar Azam turns it behind square on the leg side for a comfortable run.
Back of a length outside off, a back foot punch from Mohammad Hafeez towards cover-point sees him getting a single.

Back of a length around off, Babar Azam stays back and taps it down on the off side. Rushes to the other end to complete the run. Walton busts his guts to get to the ball but then does nothing with it. Single is taken.
Carlos Brathwaite brings himself on to bowl.
Turning in from around off, the wrong 'un, defended solidly from within the crease.
Outside off on a shorter length, punched away off the back foot for no run.
Fires it full on a flatter trajectory, Hafeez is struck on the front pad as he looks to sweep it away. Stifled shout for a leg before but it's turned down.
Mohammad Hafeez is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Kamran departs in search of the big shot. Gets a full toss on middle and leg, he kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. Doesn't middle it well at all and it's into the hands of Evin Lewis who runs in and takes a simple catch. Badree has the last laugh. Pakistan lose another wicket. 72 needed off 87 balls.

SIX! Superb shot! Full ball on the stumps, Kamran Akmal makes room for himself by clearing his front leg, goes inside out over the covers and sends it sailing into the stands for a biggie. Marvelously hit, that.
Wide! Full down the leg side, leaves it alone and it's a wide.
FOUR! Darted on the pads, Kamran sweeps it fine down the leg side, beats the keeper and sends it across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery around off, Azam gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
FOUR! Good shot! Short outside off again, Babar gets it in a good position this time and pulls it beautifully through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Another short delivery into the body, Babar Azam hops in his crease to defend it.
Babar Azam is the next batsman in.

OUT! Shehzad departs! Another delivery on a shorter length around off at 124 kph, Shehzad stands tall in his crease and tries to feel it outside off. Gets beaten by the away movement and the extra bounce as he manages to nick it straight to the keeper. Holder draws first blood.
FOUR! Brute! Short delivery into the body, Shehzad dances down the track and smacks that powerfully through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short around off, Shehzad stays in his crease and goes for a slash. He misses it completely.
Jason Holder will also have a change of ends.
Floated outside off, Akmal stays deep in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Akmal drives it down the ground. Badree dives to his right to make a fine stop.
Floated around off, Akmal sweeps it towards square leg. The fielder cannot stop it properly and the batsmen pick up two runs.
Short and wide outside off, Akmal cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Eased towards long on for a single.
Down the leg side, Shehzad clips it towards square leg. The fielder is quick to reach there and Shehzad is sent back by Akmal as he calls for a single.
Samuel Badree has a change of ends.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! Loose from Narine! Short and wide outside off, Akmal stays deep in his crease and slashes it through point for a boundary.
Eased towards long on for a single.
Short around off, Shehzad dances down the track and goes for the flick. He misses it and gets hit on the pads.
Down the leg side, Shehzad gets an inside edge towards square leg.
Tossed up outside off, Shehzad pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Sunil Narine is called in for a bowl.

FOUR! Akmal takes on the charge! On a fuller length around off, Kamran Akmal senses the length well as he goes to loft it over the extra cover region. Manages to get an outside edge over covers for a boundary. Risky but gets away.
Full delivery angling in, Akmal prods forward and defends it.
Length delivery into the pads, Shehzad pushes it with soft hands towards the fielder at mid on. Picks up a single there.
Full delivery into the pads, Akmal clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Kamran gets behind the line of the ball and defends it on the off side.
Full and angling into the stumps, Akmal drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Jason Holder will be bowling from the other end.

FOUR! Timed to precision! Short and around off, Shehzad stays in his crease and cuts it fine through the gap between backward point and short third man. Rovman Powell starts really late and gives it a chase to stop the boundary. He thinks of putting in a dive to save the boundary but does otherwise as the ball had nearly crossed the ropes. He then tries to stop himself but the momentum takes him over the ropes and he crashes into the hoardings. Actually bundles over it. Seems to be fine.
A bit short this time, Shehzad camps back and flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Drifting into the pads, Ahmed Shehzad clips it but straight to the fielder at short fine leg.
Full in the line of the stumps, Akmal drives it towards mid on for a single. First runs for Kamran Akmal in three years.
Floated outside off, Akmal shuffles across and guides it towards the fielder at point.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Akmal prods forward and defends the first ball of the innings.
The players are out in the middle for the chase. Ahmed Shehzad and Kamran Akmal will open the batting while Samuel Badree will start the proceedings for West Indies.
